items.title: Build the privacy-safe Android debt progress home-screen widget
items.outcome: An opted-in Android user sees a privacy-safe debt progress widget whose stale, locked and no-data states never expose balances or bypass authentication.
items.context: The debt-free countdown is the retention hook, but a launcher widget was previously unowned and can leak sensitive data on shared or locked devices.
scope: Progress-only default with optional approved detail
acceptance_criteria: Default widget contains no amount, debt name, merchant, salary or household data
Every state matches T-UXA-15 and stale never appears current
TalkBack, size and battery tests pass
contracts_schema: Consumes privacy-safe debt status/freshness fields; performs no financial calculation
security_privacy: No sensitive launcher, screenshot, log or analytics content
observability: Opt-in, refresh class, stale state and authenticated landing without financial data
rollout_rollback: Default off and cohort-gated after privacy review
Rollback stops updates and clears widget data
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo android. Owns the Glance implementation only and consumes server/client debt status plus the approved widget artifact.
definition_of_done: All acceptance criteria automated or evidenced
Declared dependencies mirrored as native GitHub blockedBy edges

items.title: Build the admin operator roster, lifecycle and qualification screens
items.outcome: Authorized lifecycle managers operate joiner, mover, leaver, qualification and recertification workflows from the admin console with before/after diffs and no self-approval.
items.context: T-ADM-06 owns lifecycle enforcement but no admin ticket renders the roster or workflows designed by T-UXM-03.
acceptance_criteria: Role-absent users cannot reach the routes
Every change shows added/removed capabilities before commit
contracts_schema: Consumes T-ADM-06 lifecycle and T-GOV-03 qualification contracts without local role logic
observability: Lifecycle outcome, self-approval block and recertification age
rollout_rollback: Rollback disables mutations and leaves roster read-only
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo admin. Owns lifecycle UI; API remains authoritative and the shared shell owns session/navigation.

items.title: Build admin unmask, elevation, bulk export and break-glass workflows
items.outcome: Operators request and approve high-risk access through purpose-built, time-boxed and fully audited console flows with no self-approval or bypass.
items.context: Backend redaction/elevation controls exist in plan, but no explicit admin frontend ticket owns their dangerous interaction surface.
acceptance_criteria: TTL is persistent and expiry revokes mid-session
contracts_schema: Consumes T-ADM-03/T-ADM-05 contracts and T-UXM-02 D6 manifest
security_privacy: No key or unmasked fixture in tests
Fail closed on audit/notification control failure
observability: Request, denial class, approval age, expiry and break-glass outcome
rollout_rollback: Rollback disables protected actions and keeps masked views
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo admin. Owns protected workflows; API owns every authorization decision and audit write.

items.title: Build the governed production-access and restore review console
items.outcome: Qualified platform approvers inspect zero standing access, broker sessions and restore checks without receiving credentials or query results.
items.context: T-PLT-05 governs infrastructure access but needs an operable review surface designed by T-UXM-09.
acceptance_criteria: Fewer than two eligible approvers disables sessions
Restore stays unavailable until every check passes
contracts_schema: Consumes T-PLT-05 broker and restore evidence contracts
security_privacy: Subject notification and audit correlation visible
observability: Standing grant, denial, session expiry and restore result
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo admin. Owns review UI; infra broker and API audit remain authoritative.

items.title: Build admin billing lifecycle, refund and reconciliation views
items.outcome: Billing operators inspect subscription lifecycle, refunds, credits, provider drift and cross-channel conflicts through immutable, redacted and auditable views.
items.context: T-ADM-09 covers support/refund actions but no explicit admin ticket owns the complete billing operations views from T-UXM-06.
acceptance_criteria: Every state links to source event/charge without card data
No operator edits history or counters
contracts_schema: Consumes T-BIL-05 through T-BIL-10 lifecycle and audit contracts
security_privacy: No payment credentials or user financial history
Actions require support provenance where applicable
observability: View/action outcome, drift and conflict without amounts
rollout_rollback: Read-only first, actions after provider sandbox
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo admin. Owns billing operations UI; billing API remains authoritative.

items.title: Build the admin incident, red-team and release evidence dashboard
items.outcome: Release and security operators inspect immutable scenario coverage, findings, retests, incident clocks and evidence expiry without modifying the underlying gate.
items.context: T-ADM-12 owns the red-team gate but no explicit frontend owns reviewable evidence and incident state.
acceptance_criteria: Gate result cannot be edited by viewer
contracts_schema: Consumes T-ADM-12/T-QA evidence and incident contracts
observability: Coverage, finding age, evidence expiry and incident clock
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo admin. Owns evidence dashboard only; QA/security systems own results.

items.title: Build web consent, age eligibility and privacy onboarding
items.outcome: A customer creating or returning to a web account sees the same purpose-specific consent, age eligibility, withdrawal and privacy guarantees as Android before protected processing begins.
items.context: The Android plan owns pre-onboarding consent and age eligibility, but the customer web signup path had no equivalent implementation owner. Consent and eligibility are account invariants, not mobile-only decoration.
scope: Purpose and policy-version presentation before signup completion
Consent receipt and withdrawal entry point
Denied, unavailable, expired and recovery states
acceptance_criteria: No protected processing begins before eligible purpose consent
Refusal leaves a safe unauthenticated path and creates no shadow account
Consent status and policy version come from the server ledger
Changed purpose or expired evidence requires explicit re-consent
Keyboard, screen-reader, zoom, localization and D7 conformance pass
contracts_schema: Consumes T-CMP-01 consent, purpose, policy-version and age-eligibility contracts without client-authored legal values
security_privacy: No dark pattern, bundled purpose or inferred consent
Authorization denial and age refusal reveal no account existence
observability: Consent outcome, purpose/version, eligibility class and recovery without identity or content
rollout_rollback: Ship behind the web signup gate after approved copy
Rollback disables web registration rather than bypassing consent
items.parallel_boundary: Primary repo web. Owns web onboarding surfaces only; API consent and identity services remain authoritative.
definition_of_done: Merged behind compliance and privacy review
